objective: Generate legitimate operating revenue from existing SATA transparency infrastructure and allocate approved proceeds toward the 1,000,000,000 sats reserve target.

agentCan: prepare prospect lists from public information
prepare invoices or payment instructions for chairman approval
prepare reserve or liquidity allocation proposals
agentCannot: hold private keys or seed phrases
move BTC, SOL, SATA, USDC, or LP tokens
promise revenue, price, liquidity, return, redemption, or market support
approve paid promotion or token compensation

currentAssetsToUse: SATA social account and approved-only content queue
existing public credibility from locked liquidity and disclosed reserve

revenueStreams.label: Transparency audit for crypto teams
revenueStreams.deliverable: One-page public-readiness audit covering supply, authorities, liquidity lock, reserve claims, and disclosure gaps.
revenueStreams.paymentTiming: after draft delivery or through escrow when available

revenueStreams.label: Transparency report setup
revenueStreams.deliverable: Repo-based public report template, disclosure checklist, and deployment instructions for a client project.
revenueStreams.paymentTiming: 50% upfront only after chairman approval, 50% after delivery

revenueStreams.label: Full proof dashboard and workflow setup
revenueStreams.deliverable: Automated public report workflow, proof dashboard, public JSON endpoints, and operating runbook.

upgradePolicy.objective: Increase average deal value by moving qualified customers from a starter audit into setup or dashboard work only when the customer needs implementation help.
defaultPath: Start with the $50 transparency audit unless the customer already asks for a setup or dashboard.
Offer the $150 transparency report setup when the audit finds public-reporting gaps the customer wants fixed.
Offer the $300 full proof dashboard only when the customer wants recurring automated public reporting.
qualificationQuestions: Do you only want the gap report, or do you want help setting up the public report?
Do you need a one-time report template or an automated dashboard/workflow?
Who will approve public wording, payment terms, and final deployment on your side?
stopRules: Do not pressure a customer into a larger scope.
Do not imply the work will improve SATA price, client token price, liquidity, trading volume, or buyer demand.
Do not start paid work or send payment instructions before chairman-approved scope and invoice.

requiredEvidence: client or counterparty identifier when public or internally recorded

goToMarketRules: Lead with proof tooling and public reporting, not SATA price action.
Use Sponsored/Paid Partnership disclosure for any paid or token-compensated SATA coverage.
Prefer public, factual deliverables over engagement promises.
Do not buy fake engagement, bots, raids, or investor lists.
Do not sell hidden token allocations or make undisclosed compensation arrangements.

successCriteria: at least one paid transparency audit or setup deal
chairman-approved allocation proposal for any received funds

prohibitedRoutes: fake engagement, bots, raids, or investor lists
using the reserve as a guaranteed price floor
using private keys or seed phrases in an agent workflow

publicLanguage.allowed: SATA sells transparency tooling and public-reporting services while building its own proof-first treasury discipline.
publicLanguage.requiredCaveat: No price guarantee, no redemption promise, no revenue guarantee, and no market-support commitment.
